description: Full kitchen remodel, about 180 sq ft. New mid-range shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, tile backsplash, and luxury vinyl plank flooring. Keeping the existing layout.
Convert tub to walk-in shower in a 50 sq ft bathroom, new tile, glass enclosure, and a single vanity. Some water damage around the old tub.
Roof is leaking after a storm, missing shingles on the south slope, need asphalt shingle replacement urgently. ~1800 sq ft roof.
Repaint two bedrooms and a hallway, about 600 sq ft of wall, minor drywall patching, standard paint.
